truthPolicy: Requested, designed, generated, preflighted, committed, verified, imported, rendered, published, and Box-verified are independent states.
Compiler coverage and passing offline gates do not prove that blocks exist in the live world.
Camera and map manifests are capture contracts, not rendered post-release evidence.
A predecessor Sites deployment or database release does not publish the current Town Expansion.
A failed or hash-stale transaction, entity gate, draft register, or draft dossier cannot close the current canonical package.
Successful bounded recovery of an executed prefix restores source-state evidence for that prior package but does not convert the failed transaction into a commit.
The current canonical package was regenerated after the recovered failed attempt; prior-repin live artifacts do not bind or authorize the new hashes.
